title: Baa Juice Tropical Juice Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Tropical Juice Shortfill combines exotic fruit flavours in one vibrant mix. Juicy Pineapple, ripe Mango, and sweet Guava come together with a medley of tropical tones for a bright and sunny vape. Every puff brings a taste of summer with rich, fruity depth. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills are crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, ensuring a consistently strong taste from first puff to last.
